北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京好冷呀！体感-10℃，记得多穿点，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is very cold, feels like -10℃! Remember to bundle up and stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感4℃还伴有北风，出门加衣别着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 4℃ with a north wind. Add layers to avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感5℃。风虽不大，也要注意添衣保暖。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 5℃. Even with light wind, remember to layer up.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，但湿度高。户外活动也要注意补充水分。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and humid. Remember to hydrate well during outdoor activities.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗舒适，体感21℃。享受阳光，别忘了保湿哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and comfortable, feels like 21℃. Enjoy the sunshine, and remember to moisturize!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷，体感1℃还有风。多穿点，小心湿冷感冒！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cold and cloudy, feels like 1℃ with wind. Dress warmly to avoid the damp chill!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天体感2℃，微风添凉意。外出别忘戴围巾哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like 2℃ with a breeze. Don't forget your scarf when going out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天湿度高，体感6℃。注意保持室内通风干燥。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and humid, feels like 6℃. Keep your home ventilated and dry.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾弥漫，能见度低，体感4℃。出行注意交通安全。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy with low visibility, feels like 4℃. Drive safely when traveling.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感-1℃还有风。注意防风保暖，预防感冒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like -1℃ with wind. Stay warm and protect yourself from the wind and cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆雾气浓重，湿度很高。开车慢行，注意行车安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is very foggy and humid. Drive slowly and ensure road safety.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感-22℃！超级冷，保暖措施一定要到位！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -22℃! It's extremely cold, make sure you're well-protected!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感-15℃，冰冷刺骨。出门多穿点，小心冻伤。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -15℃, it's bitterly cold. Wear extra layers and beware of frostbite.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，湿度高。虽然不冷，但也别忘了防潮哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and humid. It's not cold, but remember to prevent dampness.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾还大风，能见度低。出行注意交通，小心慢行。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy and windy with low visibility. Be careful on the road and drive slowly.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感-5℃，北风凛冽。一定要穿厚外套，别感冒！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like -5℃ with a biting north wind. Make sure to wear a thick coat and avoid catching a cold!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感-11℃，伴有大风。请务必戴好帽子手套。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -11℃ with strong winds. Be sure to wear a hat and gloves.
